title: NSClient is not syncing to database whilst xdrip is
symptom: After moving the database to a Docker container managed within Portainer, AAPS NSClient is not syncing to that Docker container instance, while xDrip is able to sync without issues.
cause: The user speculates that the issue might be due to a difference in database name casing ('Nighscout' in Google Cloud vs 'nightscout' in docker compose) or not exporting all databases from Google Cloud. However, the thread does not definitively establish a root cause.
fix: The user resolved the issue by exporting all databases from Google Cloud and restoring them to the Docker container, and by enabling the 'web-sockets' switch to 'on' inside the configuration panel for the proxied Docker container.
evidence_quote: The second different thing that I suspect was the responsible for this more welcoming status of my docker deployment stack, was the fact that _I triggered the 'web-sockets' switch to 'on'_ inside the configuration panel for this 'proxied' docker container.
